comment: RFC 6749 4.1.2 says the server SHOULD revoke tokens issued from a replayed code; the access token is a JWT with no revocation path until the revocation work in #539. Delete this entry when #539 gives access tokens a revocation path.

The claims request parameter is deferred (register: token-issuance-and-claims) so an essential userinfo name claim under scope=openid is not released - tracked by #736. Delete this entry when #736 lands.
